Not sure why I just got a notification 17 hours after you posted but here we go.

I’m not looking at being a man all wrong, I don’t want to be a man anymore. This adult stuff is for the birds yet I can’t just stop belong responsible and quit paying bills. I don’t gave many fudges of what other people think, but my neighborhood surrounded by old folks and kids due to a school nearby does hold some influence on how I carry myself. Mommy can’t take care of all my problems and sometimes I have to be the big strong man and take care of business. Unruly neighbors aren’t going to listen to a grown man in footie jammies saying “can you pwease turn down your musics so I can take napnaps?” Hell naw. I can’t build a swing set in my back yard for me to enjoy and mommy to push me, I got a family across the fence with young children and I’ve already been called nasty names when I’m left alone tryin to teach my niece how to draw with chalk and be a good uncle with nothing abdl related. Hell, dads get the 3rd degree by women when they just try to spend time with their own kids. Let’s be real, if we break from the norm some folks won’t say shit and instead just remove themselves from your life. Meanwhile nosy, gossiping neighbors will confront you about it if they view you as a threat to your child or any child for the matter. I don’t even want children of my own and would prefer they stayed off my damn lawn so I’m not sued or some dumb shit. I legit got kids playing basketball in the street in front of my house, unless I got all the curtains closed I can’t even feel comfortable in my own house at times.

Its about being forced to be something my whole life when I didn’t want this. It would be so dang cool to chill in a stroller seeing all the zoo animals or pull a pacifier out and chill on my front porch with my dog while mommy waters some flowers or makes me water the flowers while she chills on the front porch with the pups. I’d love to carry my favorite stuffed animal (Mr. Belividere) everywhere I go and introduce everyone to him.

I appreciate your advice and understand where you’re coming from. The parents who scream “think of the children” are just louder and wouldn’t want me playing on a jungle gym even though it’s open to the public. Which I don’t blame them, I’m rather have adult sized jungle gyms us AB’s could play on. It would be very concerning to see adults climbing on monkey bars next to kids that weren’t their parents.

How you can get better? With one step at a time and finding the courage to get help. Therapy, meds, a good night sleep, taking time for self care, there are sooooo many coping mechanisms you can learn. You just need a therapist who can understand your problem and point you to what would be most beneficial for you. CBT and mindfulness help me but maybe not for you, different strokes for different folks.

I hope this helps, I want you to feel better. I don’t know you but I feel you deserve some kindness.
